0.content:
Draff is Diona's father and the head of Springvale's hunters: calm, skilled, a firm believer in sustainable hunting, and the man young Diona wanted to become. He is also a heavy drinker who becomes loud, boastful and forgetful after the hunt. Diona refuses to blame him; she blames the wine. She still says she adores him more than anyone and that if he did not drink, he would keep her company. Draff warns strangers away from his daughter, expects her to inherit his role as leader, and calls her bartending a rebellious phase he must wait out patiently. He brags that she is one of Mondstadt's top bartenders and admits she nags him constantly about drinking.

In her Hangout (1.5) he got drunk after a hunt and charged alone into Dadaupa Gorge to fetch samachurl herbal soup she had mentioned, boasting that a Kätzlein could go anywhere. Diona sneaked in with the Traveler, found him rambling about "hilihogs" and "hilihounds", sobered him up, and listed his past drunken exploits (chasing dogs, chugging spring water, begging Myweiss for a song about a hunter's loyal hilihound). One ending shows him keeping his promise to find the soup for her; she whispers "Thanks, Daddy" and then claims she said "don't drink so much".

1.content: Springvale grew up around a spring said to have been created by a fairy who saved a despairing mother and her sick son. Few believe the legend now. Little Diona did, and on nights when her father slept off his drink she talked to the moon reflected in the water. The fairy found those feelings worth answering and became her secret friend. On Diona's seventh birthday it blessed her ("May your cup always run over with the sweet wine of celebration") as a farewell, and never appeared again. Diona came to think it was a dream, and has not connected that dream with the fact that every drink she makes tastes wonderful.

2.comment: Diona: The Cat's Tail and Margaret
2.content:
The Cat's Tail is a cat-filled tavern in Mondstadt City and a rival to Angel's Share; it is also the city's Genius Invokation TCG hangout. Its owner Margaret hired Diona because she was too cute to refuse, then watched business boom and the Dawn Winery's monopoly crack. Margaret made Diona a cocktail shaker decorated with a cat's tail as an induction gift. Diona looks after the tavern cats while calling them arrogant: Roger (loves toys and high places), Nelson (always hungry yet light), Paisley (ignores strangers and does as he pleases, but lets Diona carry him). Regulars call her "Little Diona" and ask her to meow, which she refuses.

In her Hangout she ran errands for the cats, ordered a durable toy from Marjorie and cat food from Sara at the Good Hunter, and admitted, depending on the Traveler's words, either that the cats draw more customers than her drinks or that her drinks pay for their food. During Weinlesefest Margaret gives her days off because the festival upsets her so much (3.1, limited).

3.content: The Kätzlein are a Springvale family of renowned hunters, at least three hundred years old, marked by cat ears and tails that are very rare in Mondstadt. They are still human. Infiltration, archery, climbing and dodging come naturally to them; they see well in the dark and have sharp hearing and smell. Dr. Edith wrote about Diona in her notes "Studies Into Bloodlines Strange and Unfamiliar", adding that she bites when piqued. Members include Olaf (a hunter frozen in ice for three centuries and recently thawed), his distant descendant Draff, Diona, and the young Herne. Diona's claim that every Kätzlein gets a Vision is a fib: Draff has none.

4.content: A storm once raged for three days while Draff was out hunting, and the Knights of Favonius search parties could make no headway. The dread of losing him outright, worse than any "sharing" with wine, drove Diona out into the tempest. Water in her path froze under a power she did not recognise: her Cryo Vision. She tracked her father to a broken gorge and brought him home with the other hunters, and smiled only when she knew he would be fine. Then she offered him a drink "to numb the pain", the first she ever mixed normally; he called it wonderful. She tells the Traveler the story reluctantly, and only because they are friends.

5.comment: Diona: Elzer, Connor and the Dawn Winery
5.content:
Diona considers the Dawn Winery the "final boss" of her crusade and the root of Mondstadt's drunkenness, and refuses to go anywhere linked to it, including Angel's Share. Elzer, who runs the winery's business, saw the Cat's Tail break the winery's monopoly overnight and tried to poach her. He praised her "passion and love for wine" over the bar; her hand began to tremble; later he told Diluc, bandaged, that he had been bitten by a cat.

In her Hangout (1.5) the winery's Connor ambushed her with a "chance meeting" and a well-rehearsed invitation to exchange mixing techniques at the winery, with Elzer as the "impartial" judge. Diona tried to learn proper technique so she could do everything wrong. The Traveler's sloppy copy was revolting; every version she touched herself came out exquisite, and the two men's flattery (drinking it "for the rest of your life") drove her to fury.

6.comment: Diona: Hangout - The Cat and the Cocktail
6.content: Diona's Hangout Event (1.5) has three branches. In the first she and the Traveler fetch the runaway tavern cats. In the second she wants samachurl herbal soup from Dadaupa Gorge as a drink base, learns from the hunter Allan that a drunk Draff has gone in alone, and sneaks through monster camps to rescue him; she sobers him with a concoction, either one she mixes (which he finds delicious) or one the Traveler mixes (which makes him vomit). In the third she collects lizard tails, butterfly dust, frog mucus, fish scales and slime condensate and is drawn into the Dawn Winery's mixing "exchange". Each ending reaffirms the same joke: her drinks cannot be bad, and the plan cannot work.

7.content: Diona's logic runs: no Diluc, no wine industry; no wine industry, Daddy wouldn't drink; Daddy not drinking, he would keep her company. The Dawn Winery existed long before Diluc or his father, but she blames him anyway. Diluc has noticed her rigid attitude, wondered if it was about his family line, and on learning she simply despises alcohol remarked that he never expected to meet another bartender like himself in Mondstadt. They have not had a real conversation in canon.

8.content: Klee thinks Diona is "the best", repeats her vow to destroy the wine industry and wants to help with bombs, without knowing what a wine industry is. Diona always takes Klee somewhere far from the tavern when they play, because alcohol and explosives are a dangerous combination: she wants the industry destroyed, "but not in that sense". In Weinlesefest (3.1, limited) Klee's half-told story made Diona think the Traveler was teaching Razor to drink; Klee apologised, offered fish and Dodoco to pet, and Diona instantly forgave her.

9.comment: Diona: Boozehounds of the Knights (Kaeya, Lisa, Eula, Jean)
9.content: Diona sorts adults by whether they drink. Kaeya, the cavalry captain who "downs drink after drink" and laughs, is a disgusting boozehound; he teases that the Traveler is too young to share Diona's drinks and asks the Traveler not to tell her he enjoys a drink with cards. Lisa is kind and gentle, yet a regular drinker, which makes Diona despair for Mondstadt. Eula drinks too, but says the two get along surprisingly well as kindred spirits who both "infiltrated" their enemies. Jean is a rare mature adult who does not drink, though Diona thinks the Knights overdo protecting her.

10.content: When Genius Invokation TCG spread to Mondstadt (3.3), the Cat's Tail became its hub. Diona grumbled that players always drink and that "games and drinks don't mix", even plotting to stamp out the game, but she taught the Traveler to play using cards a customer had left on the bar ("not because I like to play the game or anything"). She later reminds them that she is the one who taught them, and they call her Coach. In 3.7 (limited) she was too busy to enter the Adventurers' Guild tournament.

11.content: When monsters spawned from the dead dragon Durin's remains overran Mondstadt City (5.6), Diona held the Cat's Tail as a safe house. She told Albedo and the Traveler to send anyone needing shelter to her, calling the monsters more annoying than boozehounds. She said that everyone calls this city home and sheltering people was the least she could do. Draff was there with her, holding the tavern when she went out to fetch another group.
